The chart’s use of growth rates means it is tracking year-to-year percentage changes rather than levels of output.

The chart does not by itself identify the causes of each fluctuation.
The image alone is insufficient to recover exact annual values or to test statistical relationships such as correlation between agriculture and GDP.
